prompt:

Each entire sticker, including every fragment and shadow, must stay in the CENTRAL 70% width and height of its own cell. Leave broad empty transparent gutters between stickers and around all canvas edges.
Typography: draw ONE bold wordmark, then DUPLICATE THAT EXACT WORDMARK in all three cells. Same glyph shapes, same baseline, same letter spacing, same text bounds, same angle and center anchor at (50%,50%) within each cell. Keep the full specified text legible in ALL THREE cells, including the first. Do not redraw or mutate lettering between frames. Animate the EFFECTS ONLY. Each cell must read well at 256x256.
Frame order: left=onset (contained motion); middle=peak (strongest effect); right=aftershock (dispersing residual effect). This is a controlled progression of the SAME design, not three unrelated logos.
Art: chunky shapes, clean antialiased edges, opaque lettering with thick dark outlines, crisp readable hierarchy, limited fine detail. No characters, no UI frame, no scenery, no flat background, no painted checkerboard, no extra text, no numbers, no captions, no logos or watermarks.
Avoid the previous pack's generic fiery radial starburst, flying rocks and orange explosions unless explicitly requested below. Every new message needs its OWN silhouette, material, motion and palette.
Specific visual and motion direction: Flat bold comic effect: giant IVORY block letters with thick black outline and turquoise offset face shadow, backed by a compact DARK CHARCOAL STONE SLAB with teal edge highlights. The slab fractures into chunky geometric plate fragments around the outside without disturbing the word. Onset: intact cracked angular slab; peak: bold widening cracks and nearby angular fragments; aftershock: fragments separate outward. Flattened heavy rectangular silhouette, stark high contrast, limited teal halftone. NO flames, no round starburst, no glowing embers.
Text (verbatim, repeated exactly ONCE in EACH cell): "SMASH!". Spell it exactly: S M A S H !.
Input image role: the supplied comic sound-effect sheet is VISUAL INSPIRATION ONLY for flat color, thick outlines, halftone and varied silhouettes. Create the single specified NEW three-frame word asset. Do not reproduce the sheet layout or any other words from it.
FINAL LAYOUT OVERRIDE: Leave a full 20% EMPTY TRANSPARENT BORDER on every side within EACH square cell; the ENTIRE word AND all effects fit in the middle 60% square. The three stickers must be SMALL with WIDE transparent gaps, not almost touching. No effect line, wedge, spring or fragment may reach a cell boundary. Reduce the entire sticker to fit, never crop it.
